Res.Caption: Capacity Limit Percent
Res.FullDescription: The percentage of a resource's full capacity which can be utilized by work in this buffer.

Res.Caption: CCR Candidate Since (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The time this resource was first considered Capacity Constrained.

Res.Caption: Designated Capacity Constrained Resource
Res.FullDescription: Designating a resource as Capacity Constrained, when its Release Group is in Constrained Mode, will cause its full capacity to depend on a Constraint sub-component rather than the Buffer Load Limit.

Res.Caption: Designated as CCR By
Res.FullDescription: The staff member who designated this staff as a CCR

Res.Caption: Persistently Overloaded
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this resource has been considered a Capacity Constrained Resource for a reasonable amount of time.

Res.Caption: Startable Workflow Limit
Res.FullDescription: Indicates the maximum number of workflows that are startable for this staff before the Release Gate will stop releasing to them.
